cat <<'EOF' > config/initializers/storage_tracking.rb
module ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageTracking
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    after_create_commit :sync_storage_later
    after_destroy_commit :sync_storage_later_on_destroy
  end

  def delete
    storable = storage_storable
    super.tap do
      if storable.present?
        ActiveRecord.after_all_transactions_commit do
          storable.sync_storage_later unless storable.destroyed?
        end
      end
    end
  end

  private
    def sync_storage_later
      storage_storable&.sync_storage_later
    end

    def sync_storage_later_on_destroy
      storable = storage_storable
      storable.sync_storage_later if storable.present? && !storable.destroyed?
    end

    def storage_storable
      case record_type
      when "Card"
        record if name == "image"
      when "ActionText::RichText"
        if name == "embeds" && record&.record_type&.in?(%w[ Board Card Comment ])
          record.record
        end
      end
    end
end

module ActiveStorageDetachManyStorageTracking
  def detach
    storable = if record.is_a?(ActionText::RichText) && record.record_type.in?(%w[ Board Card Comment ])
      record.record
    end

    super.tap do
      if storable.present?
        ActiveRecord.after_all_transactions_commit do
          storable.sync_storage_later unless storable.destroyed?
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module ActionTextRichTextStorageTracking
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    after_destroy_commit :sync_storage_later_on_destroy, if: -> { destroyed_by_association.nil? && record_type.in?(%w[ Board Card Comment ]) }
  end

  private
    def sync_storage_later_on_destroy
      record&.sync_storage_later
    end
end

ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment) do
  include ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageTracking
  ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachMany.prepend(ActiveStorageDetachManyStorageTracking)
end

ActiveSupport.on_load(:action_text_rich_text) do
  include ActionTextRichTextStorageTracking
end
EOF

    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used

    # Re-attach and purge synchronously
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.attach(blob1)
    end
    assert_equal blob1.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.purge
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used

    # Re-attach and detach
    blob3 = create_blob("third image")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.attach(blob3)
    end
    assert_equal blob3.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.detach
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used

    # Re-attach and clear via update!(image: nil)
    blob4 = create_blob("fourth image")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.attach(blob4)
    end
    assert_equal blob4.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(image: nil)
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "updates bytes_used when rich text embeds are edited or detached" do
    blob1 = create_blob("embed one")
    blob2 = create_blob("embed two is longer")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Rich text card", creator: @user, status: "published")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(description: embed_html(blob1, blob2))
    end
    assert_equal blob1.byte_size + blob2.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

    # Remove one embed
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(description: embed_html(blob2))
    end
    assert_equal blob2.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

    # Detach remaining embeds via embeds.detach
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.rich_text_description.embeds.detach
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "updates bytes_used when card moves to another board" do
    image_blob = create_blob("card image")
    desc_blob = create_blob("card desc")
    comment_blob = create_blob("comment file")
    board_blob = create_blob("board desc")

    card = nil
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Movable card",
        creator: @user,
        status: "published",
        image: image_blob,
        description: embed_html(desc_blob)
      )
      card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    end

    card_total = image_blob.byte_size + desc_blob.byte_size + comment_blob.byte_size
    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size + card_total, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size + card_total, @account.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.move_to(@other_board)
    end

    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal card_total, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size + card_total, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "updates bytes_used when comment, card, or board is destroyed" do
    board_blob = create_blob("board file")
    image_blob = create_blob("card image")
    desc_blob = create_blob("card desc")
    comment_blob_1 = create_blob("comment 1")
    comment_blob_2 = create_blob("comment 2")

    card = nil
    comment1 = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Destroyable card",
        creator: @user,
        status: "published",
        image: image_blob,
        description: embed_html(desc_blob)
      )
      comment1 = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob_1))
      card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob_2))
    end

    total = board_blob.byte_size + image_blob.byte_size + desc_blob.byte_size + comment_blob_1.byte_size + comment_blob_2.byte_size
    assert_equal total, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal total, @account.bytes_used

    # Destroy single comment
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      comment1.destroy!
    end
    expected_after_comment = total - comment_blob_1.byte_size
    assert_equal expected_after_comment, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal expected_after_comment, @account.bytes_used

    # Destroy card (with image, description, and remaining comment)
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.destroy!
    end
    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal board_blob.byte_size, @account.bytes_used

    # Destroy board
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.destroy!
    end
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(board_id: @board.id).count
  end

  test "destroying account cleans up all storage tracking records" do
    blob = create_blob("account file")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Card", creator: @user, status: "published", image: blob)
    end

    assert Storage::Entry.where(account_id: @account.id).exists?
    assert Storage::Total.where(account_id: @account.id).exists?

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @account.destroy!
    end

    assert_not Storage::Entry.where(account_id: @account.id).exists?
    assert_not Storage::Total.where(account_id: @account.id).exists?
    assert_not Storage::Delta.where(account_id: @account.id).exists?
  end

  test "operations are idempotent when jobs run multiple times" do
    blob = create_blob("idempotent file")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Card", creator: @user, status: "published", image: blob)

    # Run sync multiple times
    3.times { card.sync_storage_now }
    Storage::Total.materialize(@board)
    Storage::Total.materialize(@account)
    Storage::Total.materialize(@board)
    Storage::Total.materialize(@account)

    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @account.bytes_used

    # Move card and run move multiple times
    card.update!(board: @other_board)
    3.times { card.move_storage_now }
    Storage::Total.materialize(@board)
    Storage::Total.materialize(@other_board)

    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @account.bytes_used

    # Destroy card and run remove multiple times
    card_id = card.id
    card.destroy!
    3.times { Storage::Entry.remove_card(card_id: card_id, account_id: @account.id) }
    Storage::Total.materialize(@other_board)
    Storage::Total.materialize(@account)

    assert_equal 0, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "creating and destroying card before sync job runs results in zero usage" do
    blob = create_blob("ephemeral file")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Ephemeral", creator: @user, status: "published", image: blob)
      card.destroy!
    end

    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "works when perform_enqueued_jobs runs a single batch without a block" do
    blob = create_blob("single flush file")
    @board.cards.create!(title: "Card", creator: @user, status: "published", image: blob)

    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @account.bytes_used

    # MaterializeAllJob compacts remaining deltas
    Storage::MaterializeAllJob.perform_now
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Delta.where(owner: [ @board, @account ]).count
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal blob.byte_size, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "reconciles storage after account export and import" do
    board_blob = create_blob("board export file")
    card_blob = create_blob("card export file")
    comment_blob = create_blob("comment export file")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Exported card", creator: @user, status: "published", image: card_blob)
      card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    end

    expected_total = board_blob.byte_size + card_blob.byte_size + comment_blob.byte_size
    assert_equal expected_total, @account.bytes_used

    export = Account::Export.create!(account: @account, user: @user)
    export.build

    export_tempfile = Tempfile.new([ "export", ".zip" ])
    export.file.open { |f| FileUtils.cp(f.path, export_tempfile.path) }

    @account.destroy!

    target_account = Account.create_with_owner(account: { name: "Imported" }, owner: { identity: @user.identity, name: @user.name })
    import = Account::Import.create!(identity: @user.identity, account: target_account)
    Current.set(account: target_account) do
      import.file.attach(io: File.open(export_tempfile.path), filename: "export.zip", content_type: "application/zip")
    end

    import.check
    import.process

    assert_equal expected_total, target_account.bytes_used
    imported_board = target_account.boards.find_by!(name: @board.name)
    assert_equal expected_total, imported_board.bytes_used
  ensure
    export_tempfile&.close
    export_tempfile&.unlink
  end

  private
    def create_blob(content)
      ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
        io: StringIO.new(content),
        filename: "file_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}.txt",
        content_type: "text/plain"
      )
    end

    def create_image_blob(fixture_name, content_type)
      ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
        io: File.open(file_fixture(fixture_name)),
        filename: fixture_name,
        content_type: content_type
      )
    end

    def embed_html(*blobs)
      blobs.map do |blob|
        %(<action-text-attachment sgid="#{blob.attachable_sgid}"></action-text-attachment>)
      end.join
    end
end

**Debugging ActiveStorage Attachment Failures in Tests**

Right, so I see why that `@user.avatar.attach(...)` call failed inside `perform_enqueued_jobs`. The problem is in `test/test_helper.rb`, specifically line 58. The `perform_enqueued_jobs` method *temporarily* sets `Current.account` to `nil`. This is the culprit! It looks like `ActiveStorage::Blob` uses `Current.account` as a default value for the `account` association when creating a blob, and obviously this needs to be there at the time it's being written to the database.

I remember now, the `user/avatar_test.rb` test works *outside* `perform_enqueued_jobs` because `Current.account` is properly set in the `setup` method. It seems like the validation on the `ActiveStorage::Blob`'s `account` field is what's failing when we try to do the attachment *inside* `perform_enqueued_jobs` because of that `Current.account` reset.

The takeaway? If we want to attach an avatar *inside* `perform_enqueued_jobs`, we have a couple of options:
   1.  Either we need to create the blob *outside* of the `perform_enqueued_jobs` block (where `Current.account` is valid).
   2.  Or we can use `Current.set(account: @account) { ... }` within the `perform_enqueued_jobs` block.
   3.  We *could* just set `Current.account` back to something valid.

The best approach seems to be attaching *before* calling `perform_enqueued_jobs`, or call `perform_enqueued_jobs` after the attachment, or explicitly passing `Current.account` into the block. This highlights that background jobs shouldn't rely on `Current.account` being set. In fact, if we can attach *before* calling `perform_enqueued_jobs`, that's the best option, and it's a test for the original problem!

Okay, so the fix is, for the test, is to set up the attachments while `Current.account` is correctly set, then call `perform_enqueued_jobs`! Also, `perform_enqueued_jobs` will work if blobs are created outside the scope or inside the scope with a block that sets `Current.account`.

class Storage::Delta < ApplicationRecord
  self.table_name = "storage_deltas"

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :owner, polymorphic: true

  class << self
    def record(account_id:, owner_type:, owner_id:, delta:)
      return if delta.zero?

      had_pending = where(owner_type: owner_type, owner_id: owner_id).exists?
      create!(account_id: account_id, owner_type: owner_type, owner_id: owner_id, delta: delta)

      unless had_pending
        if owner = owner_type.constantize.find_by(id: owner_id)
          Storage::MaterializeJob.perform_later(owner)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

**Deep Dive into Storage Edge Cases**

Wow, these test failures are revealing some seriously gnarly edge cases! Let's break down each one.

### **Failure 1: Purge-Later and the Deleted Blob**

Okay, here's the issue: We're purging a blob (`blob1`) with `purge_later`, but then immediately trying to attach it again. `purge_later` schedules a job that *destroys* the blob. The subsequent `attach` tries to use a deleted record! The solution here is to ensure that when we use `purge_later`, we re-attach a *new* blob. Essentially, after a `purge_later`, a new blob must be created, rather than re-attaching the original deleted blob.

### **Failure 2: Transactions, `after_update`, and Saved Changes**

This one's a classic! We have an `after_update` callback (`handle_board_change`) that, within the *same* transaction, calls `update! column: nil`. Rails's `saved_change_to_board_id?` only reflects the *most recent* change. So, the first `update!` triggers `handle_board_change`, but the *second* update (setting a column to `nil`) clears `saved_change_to_board_id?`. Therefore, the `after_update_commit` callback that *should* run, based on `saved_change_to_board_id?`, doesn't! The fix is to track the `board_id` change using a separate instance variable or `before_commit`/`after_save` hooks to ensure it's not affected by intermediate updates in the same transaction.

### **Failure 3: Destroying Records and Orphaned Storage**

This is subtle. We have a `Card` that's destroyed. `Card` also has many `Comment`s, and the test's `after_destroy_commit` hook in `Storage::Tracked` and `Card::Storage` is leading to this. The problem? When a `Card` is destroyed, the associated `Comment`s are *also* destroyed. However, the `Storage::RemoveRecordJob` (from `Storage::Tracked`) is called instead of `Storage::RemoveCardJob`! This is due to the `private` definition of `remove_storage_later` in the included `Storage::Tracked`, shadowing `Card::Storage#remove_storage_later`, leaving the comment's storage entry behind. To fix this, we need to ensure the correct job is enqueued in the correct destroy context and remove the `private` accessor to `remove_storage_later` in the concern so that the correct job runs.

### **Errors 4 & 5: Identity and Account Import**

*   **Error 4**: The `Identity` model has an `avatar` attachment, but no `account` association. This is causing issues because the `ActiveStorage::Attachment` model has a `belongs_to :account` association. Need to check how `Identity` avatars are being tested to understand if the test is setting `account: nil` or a `blob` directly.
*   **Error 5**: During an account import, we're deleting blobs linked to the source account *before* the account is destroyed. This is happening due to the `dependent: :purge_later` on the `Card#image` attachment. This needs checking to see whether `purge_later` is asynchronous or not.

I need to dig into `test/models/identity_test.rb` (and `uuid_framework_models.rb`) and the account import test specifically to fix these last two issues, but the overall picture is clear. We're dealing with tricky scenarios around asynchronous jobs, transactions, callbacks, and orphaned storage entries. These tests are incredibly valuable for uncovering these edge cases and strengthening our data integrity. Time to put on the debugging hat and get these fixes in!

    *   Or have `Board` include `Storage::Tracked, Board::Storage`.
    *   I need to remember that `ActiveSupport::Concern` puts dependencies AFTER the dependent module in `ancestors` so the dependent module's methods OVERRIDE the dependency!

I've got to verify that including `Storage::Tracked` *outside* the `included do` block in an `ActiveSupport::Concern` module will allow the dependent module to override the tracked module.

    after_destroy :delete_storage_records

        record_type.constantize.where(id: ids).find_each(&:sync_storage_now)

class Storage::Entry < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :board
  belongs_to :card, optional: true
  belongs_to :record, polymorphic: true

  class << self
    def sync(record)
      attempts = 0

      begin
        transaction do
          return unless record.class.exists?(record.id)

          entry = lock.find_by(record: record)
          new_bytes = record.storage_bytes_used
          new_board_id = record.storage_board_id

          if entry.nil?
            create_entry(record, new_board_id, new_bytes) if new_bytes.nonzero?
          elsif entry.board_id != new_board_id
            move_and_update_entry(entry, record, new_board_id, new_bytes)
          else
            update_entry(entry, new_bytes)
          end
        end
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique, ActiveRecord::Deadlocked
        attempts += 1
        retry if attempts < 5
        raise
      end
    end

    def move_card(card)
      new_board_id = card.board_id

      transaction do
        entries = lock.where(card_id: card.id).where.not(board_id: new_board_id).to_a
        return if entries.empty?

        entries.group_by(&:board_id).each do |old_board_id, board_entries|
          moved_bytes = board_entries.sum(&:bytes_used)
          next if moved_bytes.zero?

          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: card.account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: old_board_id, delta: -moved_bytes) if Board.exists?(old_board_id)
          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: card.account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: new_board_id, delta: moved_bytes)
        end

        where(id: entries.map(&:id)).update_all(board_id: new_board_id)
      end
    end

    def remove_record(record_type:, record_id:, account_id:)
      transaction do
        entry = lock.find_by(record_type: record_type, record_id: record_id)
        return unless entry

        bytes = entry.bytes_used
        board_id = entry.board_id
        entry.destroy!

        if bytes.nonzero?
          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id, delta: -bytes) if Board.exists?(board_id)
          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id, delta: -bytes) if Account.exists?(account_id)
        end
      end
    end

    def remove_card(card_id:, account_id:)
      transaction do
        entries = lock.where(card_id: card_id).to_a
        return if entries.empty?

        total_bytes = entries.sum(&:bytes_used)

        entries.group_by(&:board_id).each do |board_id, board_entries|
          board_bytes = board_entries.sum(&:bytes_used)
          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id, delta: -board_bytes) if board_bytes.nonzero? && Board.exists?(board_id)
        end

        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id, delta: -total_bytes) if total_bytes.nonzero? && Account.exists?(account_id)

        where(id: entries.map(&:id)).delete_all
      end
    end

    def remove_board(board_id:, account_id:)
      loop do
        has_more = transaction do
          batch = lock.where(board_id: board_id).limit(1000).pluck(:id, :card_id, :bytes_used)
          break false if batch.empty?

          card_ids = batch.filter_map { |_, card_id, _| card_id }.uniq
          moved_cards = card_ids.any? ? Card.where(id: card_ids).pluck(:id, :board_id).to_h : {}

          delete_ids = []
          removed_bytes = 0

          batch.each do |id, card_id, bytes_used|
            if new_board_id = moved_cards[card_id]
              where(id: id).update_all(board_id: new_board_id)
              Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: new_board_id, delta: bytes_used) if bytes_used.nonzero?
            else
              delete_ids << id
              removed_bytes += bytes_used
            end
          end

          where(id: delete_ids).delete_all if delete_ids.any?
          Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id, delta: -removed_bytes) if removed_bytes.nonzero? && Account.exists?(account_id)

          batch.size == 1000
        end

        break unless has_more
      end
    end

    private
      def create_entry(record, board_id, bytes_used)
        create!(
          account_id: record.account_id,
          board_id: board_id,
          card_id: record.storage_card_id,
          record: record,
          bytes_used: bytes_used
        )

        record_board_and_account_deltas(account_id: record.account_id, board_id: board_id, delta: bytes_used)
      end

      def move_and_update_entry(entry, record, new_board_id, new_bytes)
        old_bytes = entry.bytes_used
        old_board_id = entry.board_id

        if new_bytes.zero?
          entry.destroy!
        else
          entry.update!(board_id: new_board_id, bytes_used: new_bytes)
        end

        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: record.account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: old_board_id, delta: -old_bytes) if old_bytes.nonzero? && Board.exists?(old_board_id)
        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: record.account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: new_board_id, delta: new_bytes) if new_bytes.nonzero?

        account_delta = new_bytes - old_bytes
        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: record.account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: record.account_id, delta: account_delta) if account_delta.nonzero?
      end

      def update_entry(entry, new_bytes)
        delta = new_bytes - entry.bytes_used
        return if delta.zero?

        if new_bytes.zero?
          entry.destroy!
        else
          entry.update!(bytes_used: new_bytes)
        end

        record_board_and_account_deltas(account_id: entry.account_id, board_id: entry.board_id, delta: delta)
      end

      def record_board_and_account_deltas(account_id:, board_id:, delta:)
        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id, delta: delta)
        Storage::Delta.record(account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id, delta: delta)
      end
  end
end
